Sonia was a notorious mass murderer, which was hired for her fighting ability as an UFS soldier.

She appears in both Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena and Taimanin RPGX.


Personality
Remained hidden, for most of her life performed multiple murderous with no clear pattern for victims and gained pleasure from the extreme violence. She has excellent instincts, and seems to be driven mostly by her desire for pleasure and, which is rather twisted. Sonia displays signs of a hematolagnia fetish, and draws blood of others or herself at times.

At some point, went postal, while teaching, and any facade of a normal person has since then disappeared. Sonia is a sadist and does not hide her lust, that she gains from inflicting or receiving pain and death. While, she is able to work with others, she grows often bored by tasks and is willing to kill allies if they annoy her.

As she is considered insane, and lacks impulse control, even with UFS tech keeping her in line, she can be as dangerous to her enemies as to her allies.

Appearance
Sonia has blond short hair, medium bust and purple eyes. Her hands can be turned into metal claws.


History
Background
The person that later became known as No16 Sonia, was feared in the UFS as a serial killer active in the UFS, which killed both humans and demons. Those murders, were cruel enough that an investigation team assumed she herself was a demon. At the point she was caught, Sonia had already killed more than 100 people.

Her true identity was Sonia, a school teacher, and her capture was broadcasted in the UFS and she became infamous around the world, as one of the worst serial killer cases in recent history. Unknown why, Sonia suddently had started to decapitate, one of her students and started a bloodbath as the police arrived. A trial was then held, and she was sentenced to death, on the same day. However, a UFS researcher who had noticed her talent offered a deal. In exchange for her life, she was reborn as a Nanomachine cyborg and tampered by the researcher with "training", to keep her mind somewhat stable.

Sonia afterward became an agent/assassin of the UFS and even developed some comradery to them. In regard to strength, she is around the powers of a mid level demon.

Timeline TABA
In her story event, the UFS gave up early on her, and was about to be disposed of, along with the Fuuma Organization members she was meant to kill. Sonia was rescued by Fuuma Kotaro, who could not abandon Sonia, she joined him if only temporarily.

Through this interaction, she took a liking to Kotaro and locked onto him as the target of her one-sided "cutting and tearing" fetish. To remain alive, Sonia began a freelance mercenary business, not belonging to any specific organization, and often accidentally ran into Kotaro on her assignments.

Kotaro spoke highly of her, saying, despite her personality problems, she is a solid asset if she set in the field. As she developed feelings, this turned out to be a problem, as she wished to kill Fuuma Kotaro (TABA). During a watch of fireworks display with Sagiri Yui, she split with Yui and started to look for Kotaro and started to randomly hunt him down. As Kotaro himself struggled with Brunhilde, which was on her own "husband hunt", Sonia fought against Bunhilde but was in the end knocked out. She, afterward, appears to have slightly calm down again for some time.

Timeline RPGX
Encounters the Independent Rangers and teams up with Fuuma Kotaro from time to time.

Appeared first in a mission, regarding "Watanabe Suzuki", and the illegal selling of drone technology of the UFS. Forced to work together with Fuuma Kotaro, Kousaka Shizuru and Uehara Shikanosuke, it does not take long for the group to hunt down Suzuki, but they are attacked by a rival UFS group, which wishes to kill Sonia.

In another event, by chance, met Kotaro and Amamiya Shisui while on a hunt for a target and forced them to help out. Together with the Taimanin, her orc partner Alphonse and dark elf sniper Alberta, they killed the crazed killer Scient.

As part of her reform, Sonia worked also undercover as a teacher, and solved the case of disappearing students and captured an Imitator demon.
